bullets.text: Contributing to a Node.js backend codebase for the tax-generation service, building and maintaining APIs for core workflow execution.
Implementing backend logic and service integrations with a focus on correctness, maintainability, and production readiness.
Working with the engineering team to debug issues, support feature delivery, and improve service reliability in a remote environment.
Built and optimized backend services in Python/Django within a production architecture.
Reduced API latency by 30% through query tuning and execution plan analysis.
Worked on deployments, backend integrations, and debugging service dependencies.
Reduced time-to-first-byte from 3s to 200ms by optimizing streaming architecture.

projects.name: Telescope
bullets: Built distributed ingestion pipeline processing 500k+ events/sec.
Designed consumer groups and partitioning for horizontal scaling.
Implemented LSM-inspired storage layer improving throughput and query latency.
Enabled near real-time search visibility.

projects.name: High-Frequency Ticketing System
bullets: Designed concurrency-safe booking system handling traffic spikes.
Implemented distributed locking and consistency controls.
Prevented overselling under concurrent demand.
Validated with k6 load testing.

projects.name: Distributed Chat System
bullets: Built horizontally scalable real-time chat backend.
Implemented Redis Pub/Sub for cross-instance synchronization.
Load tested with 1000 concurrent users.

projects.name: StackShifter
bullets: Built CLI tool to migrate React applications to Next.js automatically.
Implemented AST-driven JSX to TSX conversion and routing transformations.
Automated CSS Modules migration, file restructuring, and import path correction.

projects.name: rustVecSearch
bullets: Built multi-threaded vector search engine in Rust using Hot/Cold index architecture.
Enabled concurrent insertions with lock-free hot buffer and background cold-index flushing.
Implemented K-Means clustering for approximate nearest neighbor search.
Used Arc, RwLock, and channels for concurrent ingestion and search workloads.

projects.name: Content Broadcasting System
bullets: Built stateless backend API for scheduling and broadcasting educational media content.
Designed modulo-based rotation engine eliminating cron jobs and background workers.
Implemented role-based access control for teacher and principal workflows using JWT.
Used database locking to prevent race conditions during approval and scheduling.

projects.name: Go Rate Limiter
bullets: Built token-bucket rate limiter backed by Redis Cluster.
Implemented Lua scripts for atomic token consumption and refill logic.
Supported millisecond precision, auto-expiry, and per-user isolation.
Designed for distributed deployment across multiple nodes.

projects.name: TraceRat
bullets: Built system to predict production blast radius of GitHub pull requests before merge.
Combined dependency graph analysis, traffic telemetry, historical PR outcomes, and LLM reasoning.
Designed event-driven microservices architecture communicating over Kafka.
Generated automated PR comments with risk scores and actionable recommendations.

projects.name: Asteroid Dodger AI
bullets: Built simulation where neural network learns to control spaceship and dodge asteroids.
Visualized training progress, network structure, and real-time decision making.
Implemented save/load controls for best-performing model using browser storage.
